period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account, read from National Bank's own Q1-2020 unaudited financial statements (clean digital text). Comparative Balance Sheet column (31 Dec 2019) reproduces this dataset's existing FY2019 figures closely: total_equity 49,037,558,323, total_deposits 366,298,512,993, gross_loans 360,769,737,295 and nav_per_share 16.79 all match FY2019 exactly; total_liabilities (414,537,220,121) matches Total Assets minus Equity exactly. TOTAL ASSETS' own printed comparative shows minor OCR/text-layer noise but is consistent with the known FY2019 figure (463,574.78m). The current-period (Mar-2020) TOTAL ASSETS cell is not directly legible, so it is derived as Total Liabilities (419,785,771,453, cleanly printed) + Total Equity (50,012,585,775, cleanly printed) = 469,798,357,228. Every P&L component (net interest income, investment income, commission, other operating income, operating expenses) is cleanly printed and was independently cross-validated three times over: against this filing's own comparative column (Jan-Mar 2019, which reproduces 2019_Q1.json's figures exactly) and, later, against 2021_Q1.json's own Jan-Mar-2020 comparative column, which reproduces every one of this record's P&L figures exactly (net interest income 1,534,520,881; investment income 1,422,373,299; commission 324,201,176; other income 94,130,673; operating expenses 1,514,342,472; profit before provision 1,860,883,557; profit before tax 1,360,883,557; provision 500,000,000; tax 480,000,000; PAT 880,883,557) -- interest_income (8,899,095,964) and interest_expense (7,364,575,083) were recovered this same way, since this filing's own P&L text has that specific row corrupted for both columns. Profit before provision was not itself printed cleanly in the current-period column and is derived as Total Operating Income minus Total Operating Expenses, matching the 2021_Q1.json cross-check exactly. EPS is the filing's own printed figure.
